evidence.summary: Round 2 experiments showed that decreasing shipper_years from 40 to 32 increased the score from 0.9609 to 0.9670, while decreasing it further to 30 reduced the score to 0.9667.
Round 4 reconstruction uses the Round 1 and Round 2 datasets as training evidence and evaluates the reconstructed model against the allotted unseen Round 4 validation datapoints.
